name: River Village in a Rainstorm
material: Hanging scroll; ink and slight color on silk
dimensions: Painting: 170.5 x 103.4 cm (67 1/8 x 40 11/16 in.); Overall with knobs: 279.6 x 134.3 cm (110 1/16 x 52 7/8 in.)
summary: In this scene, windswept rain pelting a village captures the power of nature in a masterful composition.
